turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so let's not waste it. Who decided to put a zero in front of Owen before anyone picked up a phone and called me?
"Get this over with." That's how you're starting a meeting about my son's mark? I asked you a question, Hale: who decided, and why didn't anyone call me first?
Look, your son cheated. Everyone knows it. I'm not wasting my evening on this.

My child doesn't cheat, and "everyone knows it" isn't evidence, it's gossip. I'm writing that down, word for word. Either you show me something with a date on it, or I'm walking from this room to the principal's office.
You lawyers think you can bully anyone.
Nobody's bullying you, Hale. I'm asking for evidence, and you haven't put a single piece of paper on this desk. What do you have besides that machine?
Are you going to keep wasting my time?
You're the one who asked for this meeting, Hale. You've given me an accusation and no documents. If that's all you've got, I'm going upstairs to the principal's office when I walk out of here.
